source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Bacterial or fungal growth in the equipment, which could be aerosolized and inhaled into the lungs during subsequent treatments","B":"Improving how well the medication is delivered, with fairly little connection to preventing any kind of infection","C":"Damage to the nebulizer's electrical components alone, rather than reducing any infection-related risk","D":"Carrying fairly little established infection control rationale despite being a routine part of nebulizer care"}}
source_row.rationale: Regular nebulizer cleaning helps prevent bacterial or fungal growth in the equipment, which could otherwise be aerosolized and inhaled directly into the lungs during subsequent treatments, an important infection prevention consideration for this type of respiratory equipment.
source_row.source_name: AARC — Nebulizer Cleaning and Infection Control
